listNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on all 55. Hidden flags follow a documented rule (see the About page): the live pages do not expose a hidden marker per trophy. PSN progress targets are from PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; sources are cited beside each guide, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment you earn the other 54 trophies. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime, then the long grind — and this pops last. The longest poles are 100% Completion, 250 stunts and gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, so start those counters early and let them tick up while you do everything else.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger missions.
Complete the activities, collectibles and crime trophies.
Attain 100% Completion for A Long Road.
Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically.
trophies.tips: Check the Roadmap tab: it orders the whole list into six phases so nothing is left to the end. Typical total time is about 250 hours.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is an early story mission — the first fishing trip, and the mission that teaches you how fishing works. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen. It cannot be missed: story missions can be replayed, and this one comes naturally in the opening hours.
steps: Play the story until the Gone Fishing mission opens.
Follow the mission prompts and finish the fishing trip.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: Pay attention during this mission: fishing is one of the 9 activity types, and beating Cal in a fishing challenge later earns Baited My Tackle.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically at the chapter's end — there is nothing extra to find or do. If you are unsure whether a chapter is finished, the story progress screen shows which missions remain.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions in order.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's closing scene.
trophies.tips: Meditate at any spot you pass in Chapter 1 — the missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs every spot, and one is tied to the story.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically when the chapter closes. The name is shown on PlayStation exactly as written here, asterisks included.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions in order.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's closing scene.
trophies.tips: Chapter 2 opens up more of the map — use the new areas to start the open-world counters (vehicles, WAiNK scans) in passing.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy unlocks automatically at the chapter's end. By now the map is largely open, so it is a good moment to knock out a few activity trophies between story missions rather than leaving them all for after the finale.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions in order.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's closing scene.
trophies.tips: Try a race, a stunt and the shooting range between missions — they count toward Master of None and the long grind.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. The trophy unlocks automatically at the chapter's end. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions in order.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's closing scene.
trophies.tips: Before the finale, do a sweep of meditation spots you have passed — the missable trophy needs all 18, and one spot is tied to the story.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy and the last of the 12 story trophies. The finale is a full mission like any other — follow the objectives, and the trophy pops at the credits. After it, the whole map stays open for everything else on the list.
steps: Finish Chapters 1-4.
Play the final mission to its end.
The trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.tips: Do not rush past the finale: free roam after the story is where most of the remaining trophies are earned.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. Named story missions like this one cannot be missed: they are part of the main path, and the mission list shows them in order.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run opens.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: The official description names the mission, so there is no searching: it appears in the story flow.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. Heist missions are longer than ordinary ones and usually have a setup and an execution; both count as part of the same mission, so stay with it until the debrief.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist opens.
Complete the setup and the heist itself.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: Heist missions are good practice for the standalone robbery trophies later — the same stealth and driving skills apply.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is on the main path, so it cannot be missed or locked out.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play opens.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: The official description names the mission directly, so just follow the story order.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is on the main path, so it cannot be missed. The stylised name is the mission's own title.
steps: Play the story until Headliners opens.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: Story missions can be replayed after the credits, so even a failed attempt costs nothing but time.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around the airport — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is on the main path, so it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown opens.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: The airport area matters again later: Catch Me If You Can asks for an unscheduled departure from VCIA.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies before the finale, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory opens.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.tips: With the story trophies done, the roadmap's phase 2 — strangers and side stories — is the natural next step.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats). The checklist counts story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the big counters — 300 of the 397 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, all 42 drone races at the 14 Top Fun locations, and more. It is the longest single trophy on the list and usually the last one before the platinum. Work it in passes: finish the story, then sweep each category, and check the in-game list after every session so you always know what is left.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger missions.
Open Progress > Stats and read the 100% checklist.
Clear each category: stunts (300), challenges (70 of 80), drone races (all 42), and the rest.
The trophy unlocks at 100%.
trophies.tips: The standalone trophies ask for less than 100% does — 250 stunts instead of 300, 50 challenges instead of 70 — so keep going after those pop. Expect 200-300 hours in total for the platinum.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. The game counts each stunt once, and the in-game stats show your running total. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to chain — fly low under bridges in a fast plane or helicopter — while stunt jumps need a fast car and a good run-up. You only need 250 of 397, so skip the ones that fight you; 100% Completion later asks for 300.
steps: Check your stunt total in Progress > Stats.
Chain under-the-bridge flights for quick completions.
Add stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps until the counter hits 250.
trophies.tips: Do stunts in passing during the whole playthrough instead of saving all 250 for the end. A helicopter makes bridge flights far easier than a plane.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only have to try each one — no wins or scores required. Most players will have done several by accident during the story; check which are left and do one of each. The arcade, the shooting range and the basketball court are all in or near Vice City, so the rest is a short tour.
steps: Open the activities list and see which types you have tried.
Do one of each missing type: fish, hunt, play golf, shoot at the range, play pool, play basketball, finish an arcade game, race, and land a stunt.
trophies.tips: This pairs naturally with the other activity trophies — one fishing trip can count toward the fishing challenge, and one arcade game earns Stick Fiddler.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges — 6 courses each at the Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn (24 golds). Each challenge has a score threshold for gold; the game shows it before you start. Learn one weapon at a time, use cover and controlled bursts rather than spraying, and replay a course until gold — silver and bronze do not count. This is one of the two hardest trophies on the list, beside 100% Completion.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and open the challenge list.
Learn each course's gold threshold before you shoot.
Replay courses until all 42 show gold.
trophies.tips: Take breaks between courses — accuracy drops fast when you rush. A controller with steady aim settings helps more than a faster trigger finger.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 races in total (three per location), but the trophy only needs one win at each location — the full 42 are needed for 100% Completion later. Drone races are time trials through rings: learn the course on a slow first run, then race it. Cut corners only where the rings allow it.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win one race at each location.
Come back for the other two races per location if you are chasing 100%.
trophies.tips: One win per location is enough for the trophy, so do not grind all 42 until the 100% phase.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Races are scattered across Leonida in cars, bikes and boats; the race menu shows which you have won. Pick short street races first and learn their corners, then work through the longer ones. A well-upgraded car matters more than perfect driving on the longer circuits.
steps: Open the race list and note which races you have already won.
Win 20 different races across cars, bikes and boats.
trophies.tips: Repeat wins of a race you already won do not count — the word 'different' is the whole trophy. Track it in the race menu.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet during the story's fishing trip; after that, fishing challenges against him open at fishing spots. A challenge is a timed catch contest — bigger and rarer fish score more. Use the best bait you have and fish where the water is deep; reeling steadily beats reeling fast.
steps: Finish the story fishing trip to meet Cal.
Open a fishing challenge against Cal at a fishing spot.
Out-fish him before the timer ends.
trophies.tips: If you lose, you can retry the challenge — losing costs nothing but the entry time.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. The arcades are in Vice City; walk up to a cabinet, start the game and finish it. 'Complete' means reaching the end screen, not just starting it.
steps: Find an arcade in Vice City.
Start any arcade game and play it to completion.
trophies.tips: This also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the strangers — side characters with their own mission strands across Leonida. Meet Andy, play his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission completes. Stranger missions are marked on the map once you have met the character, so there is no blind searching.
steps: Meet Andy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order until the final one.
The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.tips: Stranger strands also feed Strangers & Freaks, which needs 8 completed strands — Andy is one of the eight.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton is one of the strangers with a mission strand of his own. Meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission completes. The strand is marked on the map once you have met him.
steps: Meet Kenton and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order until the final one.
The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.tips: Do the stranger strands in any order you like — they are independent of each other and of the story.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy is one of the strangers with a mission strand of his own. Meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission completes.
steps: Meet Billy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order until the final one.
The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.tips: Billy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked on the map once you meet them; each has a strand of several missions, and a strand counts when its final mission is done. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy too, so those five strands are the natural core — add any three more strangers to reach eight. The map marks strangers you have met, so work through them one at a time.
steps: Meet strangers across the map — they appear as map markers once met.
Complete 8 full strands, finishing each one's final mission.
trophies.tips: Five of the eight strands also earn their own trophies, so this trophy usually pops while you are finishing those five plus three more.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy is one of the strangers with a mission strand of his own. Meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission completes.
steps: Meet Randy and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order until the final one.
The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.tips: Randy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone is one of the strangers with a mission strand of his own. Meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission completes.
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his mission strand.
Play his missions in order until the final one.
The trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.tips: Tyrone's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE LIST'S ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one meditation spot is tied to a story moment, and if you pass it without meditating you cannot go back for it in that playthrough. So meditate at every spot the moment you find it — do not save them for a later sweep. Spots are quiet scenic places: beaches, hilltops, piers and gardens. The game marks a spot once you are near it, and meditating takes only a few seconds each.
steps: From the start of the game, meditate at every spot you pass.
Check the count in Progress > Stats after each session.
Finish all 18 spots; the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.tips: This is the one trophy that can force a second playthrough. If you are reading this before starting the game: meditate everywhere, every time. If you already missed the story-tied spot, it is faster to start over than to finish the list and find out at the end.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a stranger who asks you to hunt specific rare animals — the hunt starts from Bret, not from random wildlife. Meet Bret, take his hunt, and follow the tracking prompts to the animal's area. Unique animals are tougher than ordinary ones: approach quietly, use a scoped rifle, and do not spook it or you will chase it across the map.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunt.
Track the unique animal to its area.
Take it down cleanly and return to Bret.
trophies.tips: Hunting counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do this before you tick that trophy off.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out in the wilds — and a set completes when you hold every card in it. The collection menu shows which cards you own and which sets are close, so chase the sets with the fewest gaps first. Cards are not marked on the map by default, so use the in-game collection tracker and sweep one region at a time.
steps: Open the card collection and see which sets are closest to complete.
Sweep one region at a time for the missing cards.
Complete any 3 full sets.
trophies.tips: Do cards alongside the WAiNK scans and the map sweep — the same route covers three trophies at once.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations — any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags counts. Open your phone's WAiNK app near a marked spot, scan it, and the counter ticks up. The phone shows which spots in your area are unscanned, so work district by district instead of driving at random. You need 100 of the 89-plus marked locations, so almost every spot counts.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone near a marked location.
Scan Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Reach 100 scanned locations.
trophies.tips: Combine this with the map sweep for The Goodtime State and the card hunt — one route, three counters.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges. Challenges are small goals spread across everything you do — driving, combat, exploration, activities — and the challenge menu shows your progress on each. Many complete themselves while you play the story and the other trophies; the rest are worth doing deliberately in the cleanup phase. You only need 50 of 80, so skip the ones that fight you. Note that 100% Completion later asks for 70.
steps: Open the Challenges menu and see which are already done.
Let story and activity play finish the easy ones.
Pick off the remaining easy challenges until the counter hits 50.
trophies.tips: Do not chase all 80 now — 70 are needed for 100%, so the last 20 can wait for the final phase.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops — if they are not in the car, it does not count. Get 4 stars by committing crimes in a busy area, then drive out of the search circle and stay hidden until the stars clear. A fast car, a quiet hiding spot and patience do the job; do not fight the police, just break line of sight.
steps: Bring your partner with you.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight, leave the search area, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.
trophies.tips: Do this at night in a fast car with a full tank. If the wanted level drops to 3 stars, commit one more crime to push it back to 4 before escaping.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of Hot Together: you must KEEP the wanted level the whole time. Rob a shop, get in the car with your partner, drive straight to the next shop and rob it before the cops lose you — three in a row, no escape in between. Pick three shops close together on the same street and plan the route before the first robbery.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 shops close together.
Rob the first shop, then drive straight to the second and third.
Do not lose the wanted level between robberies — the chain breaks if you do.
trophies.tips: Use a fast getaway car parked facing the road. If the cops lose you between shops, the chain breaks and you start over.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you scan it with WAiNK or drive it — the vehicle menu shows your total. Variety is the key: sports cars, trucks, boats, bikes and planes all count, and rare vehicles in wealthy districts are worth seeking out. Driving different vehicles during normal play discovers most of them; the last few are worth a deliberate tour of car parks, docks and the airport.
steps: Check your vehicle total in the vehicle menu.
Drive and scan new vehicle types wherever you go.
Tour car parks, docks and the airport for the rare ones.
trophies.tips: A WAiNK scan is enough to discover a vehicle — you do not have to steal or keep it.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — trigger it when enemies are grouped together, not one at a time. The best spot is a gang shootout or a police ambush where enemies cluster: wait until five are in view, trigger Focus, and drop them before the meter runs out. A high-damage weapon helps, since you need five kills inside one Focus window.
steps: Find a fight where enemies cluster together.
Wait until at least 5 enemies are in view.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.
trophies.tips: Do not trigger Focus against a single enemy — the meter is wasted. Let the fight come to you, then strike.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. In plain terms: steal a plane at the airport and take off without a flight plan. Drive onto the airfield, take any plane, and get airborne. The trophy pops once you are in the air leaving the airport. Expect police attention on the runway, so take the nearest plane and go — do not linger choosing one.
steps: Go to VCIA airport and get onto the airfield.
Take any plane.
Take off — the trophy pops once you are airborne.
trophies.tips: A small fast plane is easier to steal than a jet. Enter the airfield from the service road, not the main terminal.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. Take a Rhino tank for a drive — steal one from a military area or a high-wanted-level police response — and the trophy pops once you are driving it. The official description does not say where to find one, so expect a fight to get it: build a high wanted level near a military zone and the tank comes to you.
steps: Find a Rhino tank — military areas and high wanted levels are where they appear.
Get inside it.
Drive it — the trophy pops once you are moving in the tank.
trophies.tips: The description gives no location, so this guide does not invent one: military zones and 4-5 star wanted levels are where tanks show up in this series.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses calling the police, no wanted level at all. Go at night, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. If an alarm trips, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again. A suppressed weapon and a fast getaway car parked outside make the difference.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go at night.
Enter quietly and take the goods without tripping an alarm.
Leave undetected — the trophy pops once you are clear with no wanted level.
trophies.tips: If you are spotted, do not fight it out — leave and retry. Detection, not the robbery, is what fails the trophy.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies: each needs a plan, a crew approach and a getaway. Unlike the small shop robberies, a vault robbery triggers a heavy police response, so the escape matters as much as the robbery — have a fast car and a route planned before you go in. Five separate vaults count; the same vault twice does not.
steps: Find a bank vault and plan the approach and getaway.
Rob the vault and escape the police.
Repeat at 5 different vaults.
trophies.tips: Do vaults one at a time with full preparation. A failed escape still counts as a robbery attempt, not a completed one.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — spot one, block it or ram it to a stop, take the cash, and lose the police. The robbery itself is quick; the escape is the hard part, because the truck's alarm brings a fast response. Have a getaway car ready nearby and a route out of the area planned before you strike.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape the police — the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.tips: Strike near the edge of the city so the escape is short. A sticky bomb on the rear doors opens the truck fast.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map, all 52 regions. The map shows fog over places you have not visited; every road, town and coastline counts. A plane is the fastest way: fly low over each region and the fog lifts. The counter is in Progress > Stats, so you can see exactly which regions are left instead of guessing.
steps: Check the map for fogged regions.
Fly or drive through every region until the fog clears.
The trophy pops at 52 of 52 regions explored.
trophies.tips: A plane at low altitude clears fog faster than any car. Do this on the same sweep as the WAiNK scans and card hunt.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Gangs run illegal operations — drug labs, chop shops, smuggling drops — across Leonida, and each gang's operation is a separate target. The official description does not list the gangs or their locations, so this guide does not invent a list: find operations through gang territory on the map and through story contacts, hit one per gang, and check the count after each robbery. Expect armed guards at every operation.
steps: Find an illegal operation in gang territory.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for every gang until each one is done.
trophies.tips: Go in armed and with a getaway car. Operations are guarded — stealth helps, but a fast exit matters more.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. The trophy is a quiet one: sit at a beachfront bar, buy a drink, and the trophy pops once the scene plays out. Ocean Beach is the beachfront strip in Vice City — any bar with a sea view along it should do.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Sit at a beachfront bar and order a cocktail.
The trophy pops as you drink in the view.
trophies.tips: Do this at sunset for the view — and because it is a good moment to take a break from the grind.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side — the classic smash-and-grab exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, line up a fast car outside, and drive straight through the glass and out. The trophy pops once you are out the far side. Expect a wanted level and a broken car, so use a car you do not care about.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Line up a fast car outside, facing the glass.
Drive through the showroom and out the other side.
trophies.tips: Speed matters more than the car: a long straight run-up gives you the momentum to clear the showroom in one go.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game — follow through on the lane. The name is the place: Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, and the trophy is about playing a full game there rather than a single throw. Bowl the game through to its end and the trophy pops at the final frame.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and bowl it through to the final frame.
trophies.tips: Bowling is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. A strike is not required — finishing the game is.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description gives nothing away — 'a partnership with mass appeal' is a riddle, not an instruction. What it points at is a partnership activity done to its best: play the partner activities with your partner and set a personal best together. The honest version of this guide: the official description does not say which activity or what score, so do the partner activities (bowling, darts, pool, races) with your partner and chase the best score in each — the trophy is tied to one of them. Check the partner-activity menu for a personal-best tracker to see which one is still open.
steps: Play partner activities with your partner — bowling, darts, pool, races.
Chase a personal best in each one.
Check the partner-activity tracker for the one still open.
trophies.tips: This guide does not invent a specific activity for this trophy: the description hides it, and the partner-activity tracker in the game is the source of truth.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Take 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The Criminal Profile is the game's record of what kind of criminal you are — every crime, choice and action feeds it. The description hides the number, but PSN tracks it: 500 profile-changing actions. There is no single trick: play the game, make choices, commit crimes, finish missions and activities, and the counter climbs. The profile screen shows your progress, so check it after sessions to see what is moving it fastest.
steps: Open your Criminal Profile to see the current count.
Play missions, commit crimes and finish activities — each counts.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions.
trophies.tips: This is a background counter, not a grind: by the time the rest of the list is nearly done, this is usually close too. If it lags, vary what you do — the profile rewards variety.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: 'second time's the charm'. What it means is to fail something once, then succeed on the second try — a retry trophy. The most reliable reading, from the community's guides: retry a failed activity or mission and complete it on the second attempt. If a mission or activity fails, do not reload an old save — retry it immediately and finish it, and the trophy pops on the successful second attempt.
steps: Fail a mission or activity once.
Retry it immediately — do not reload an older save.
Complete it on the second attempt.
trophies.tips: Do not force this early: it happens naturally during a long playthrough. If it has not popped by the cleanup phase, fail an easy race on purpose, then win the retry.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle: 'what the hell just happened?' points at a strange, unexplained event in the world — the kind of odd encounter that makes you stop and stare. Leonida has scripted weird encounters: strange lights, odd characters, unexplained scenes in remote places. Explore the odd corners of the map — the swamps, the desert roads, the far beaches — and trigger one of these encounters. The community's guides list the encounter spots; this guide does not invent one, because the official description names none.
steps: Explore Leonida's remote and odd corners — swamps, desert roads, far beaches.
Trigger a strange scripted encounter.
The trophy pops when the encounter plays out.
trophies.tips: This is the list's most deliberately vague trophy. If it has not popped by the cleanup phase, check a community guide for the encounter spots rather than wandering at random.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by — hit pedestrians or enemies with a melee weapon while driving past in a vehicle. The name says it: ten-pin bowling, but the pins are people and the ball is your car. Drive slowly through a crowded area, swing a melee weapon (a bat works) from the moving vehicle, and knock people down. The trophy pops once the game registers the melee drive-by.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a slow vehicle.
Drive through a crowded area.
Swing the melee weapon from the moving vehicle and bowl people over.
trophies.tips: A slow drive is better than a fast one — you need time to connect the swing. A beach promenade or a market street has the crowds.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from heists and robberies — they cannot be spent directly, so they must be laundered through contacts who take a cut. The more you rob, the more Marked Bills you hold; launder them steadily through your contacts instead of letting them pile up. The contacts menu shows how much you have laundered so far.
steps: Rob heists, vaults and shops to earn Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.
trophies.tips: Launder little and often — the contacts take a cut either way, and a steady flow beats one huge pile at the end.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything sold in a shop counts. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so most players are well on their way by the end of the story without trying. If it lags, buy weapon upgrades and car modifications — they are the biggest single purchases, and they make the rest of the list easier too.
steps: Shop normally through the story — clothes, food, ammo.
Spend the rest on weapon upgrades and car mods.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.
trophies.tips: Do not waste money on throwaway purchases early: save the big spending for upgrades you actually want.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the property menu — the map shows which are for sale, and the menu shows which you already own. They are not cheap, so this is a late-game trophy: earn money from heists and laundering first, then buy the garages in one sweep. Owning garages also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
steps: Open the property menu and list the garage properties.
Earn money from heists, robberies and laundering.
Buy every garage property.
trophies.tips: Buy garages after the story, when money is plentiful — they are a money sink, not an early purchase.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the vehicle delivery app on your phone: find a vehicle, open the app, and register it. Any 10 distinct vehicles count — cars, bikes and more. Register the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and you will finish both trophies on the same sweep.
steps: Find a vehicle you have not registered.
Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register it.
Repeat for 10 different vehicles.
trophies.tips: Register vehicles as you discover them — the two trophies share the same habit.
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
